The warning at line 19847 was about the line:
```java
if (!((bitField0_ & 0x00000001) == 0x00000001)) {
```
which is equivalent to:
```java
if ((bitField0_ & 0x00000001) != 0x00000001) {
```
Following the SonarQube guidance to avoid negated boolean checks for equality, I replaced the inversion by using the '!=' operator directly without negation.

The only change is the replacement of this line in parsing; all other code remains unmodified to preserve original semantics.
